summary: Southern Power Company filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a public offering of Series 2026A Senior Notes. The filing discloses terms of an unsecured debt issuance with no special-situation catalyst such as a merger, tender, or restructuring. The firm is raising proceeds for general corporate purposes; the notes are unsecured and rank equally with existing unsubordinated debt. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other event-driven trigger is present. The filing is a routine capital-markets transaction and does not constitute a special situation.
